verses.ar: فَمَاذَا نَقُولُ إِنَّ أَبَانَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَدْ وَجَدَ حَسَبَ ٱلْجَسَدِ؟
verses.kjv: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.web: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ إِنْ كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ قَدْ تَبَرَّرَ بِٱلْأَعْمَالِ فَلَهُ فَخْرٌ، وَلَكِنْ لَيْسَ لَدَى ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath [whereof] to glory; but not before God.
verses.web: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَاذَا يَقُولُ ٱلْكِتَابُ؟ «فَآمَنَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بِٱللهِ فَحُسِبَ لَهُ بِرًّا».
verses.kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.web: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

verses.ar: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِي يَعْمَلُ فَلَا تُحْسَبُ لَهُ ٱلْأُجْرَةُ عَلَى سَبِيلِ نِعْمَةٍ، بَلْ عَلَى سَبِيلِ دَيْنٍ.
verses.kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.web: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِي لَا يَعْمَلُ، وَلَكِنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱلَّذِي يُبَرِّرُ ٱلْفَاجِرَ، فَإِيمَانُهُ يُحْسَبُ لَهُ بِرًّا.
verses.kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.web: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

verses.ar: كَمَا يَقُولُ دَاوُدُ أَيْضًا فِي تَطْوِيبِ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلَّذِي يَحْسِبُ لَهُ ٱللهُ بِرًّا بِدُونِ أَعْمَالٍ:
verses.kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.web: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

verses.ar: «طُوبَى لِلَّذِينَ غُفِرَتْ آثَامُهُمْ وَسُتِرَتْ خَطَايَاهُمْ.
verses.kjv: [Saying], Blessed [are] they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.web: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلرَّجُلِ ٱلَّذِي لَا يَحْسِبُ لَهُ ٱلرَّبُّ خَطِيَّةً».
verses.kjv: Blessed [is] the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.web: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

verses.ar: أَفَهَذَا ٱلتَّطْوِيبُ هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْخِتَانِ فَقَطْ أَمْ عَلَى ٱلْغُرْلَةِ أَيْضًا؟ لِأَنَّنَا نَقُولُ: إِنَّهُ حُسِبَ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱلْإِيمَانُ بِرًّا.
verses.kjv: [Cometh] this blessedness then upon the circumcision [only], or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.web: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ حُسِبَ؟ أَوَهُوَ فِي ٱلْخِتَانِ أَمْ فِي ٱلْغُرْلَةِ؟ لَيْسَ فِي ٱلْخِتَانِ، بَلْ فِي ٱلْغُرْلَةِ!
verses.kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.web: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

verses.ar: وَأَخَذَ عَلَامَةَ ٱلْخِتَانِ خَتْمًا لِبِرِّ ٱلْإِيمَانِ ٱلَّذِي كَانَ فِي ٱلْغُرْلَةِ، لِيَكُونَ أَبًا لِجَمِيعِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَهُمْ فِي ٱلْغُرْلَةِ، كَيْ يُحْسَبَ لَهُمْ أَيْضًا ٱلْبِرُّ.
verses.kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which [he had yet] being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.web: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

verses.ar: وَأَبًا لِلْخِتَانِ لِلَّذِينَ لَيْسُوا مِنَ ٱلْخِتَانِ فَقَطْ، بَلْ أَيْضًا يَسْلُكُونَ فِي خُطُوَاتِ إِيمَانِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي كَانَ وَهُوَ فِي ٱلْغُرْلَةِ.
verses.kjv: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which [he had] being [yet] uncircumcised.
verses.web: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِٱلنَّامُوسِ كَانَ ٱلْوَعْدُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ أَوْ لِنَسْلِهِ أَنْ يَكُونَ وَارِثًا لِلْعَالَمِ، بَلْ بِبِرِّ ٱلْإِيمَانِ.
verses.kjv: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, [was] not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.web: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ إِنْ كَانَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِنَ ٱلنَّامُوسِ هُمْ وَرَثَةً، فَقَدْ تَعَطَّلَ ٱلْإِيمَانُ وَبَطَلَ ٱلْوَعْدُ:
verses.kjv: For if they which are of the law [be] heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.web: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلنَّامُوسَ يُنْشِئُ غَضَبًا، إِذْ حَيْثُ لَيْسَ نَامُوسٌ لَيْسَ أَيْضًا تَعَدٍّ.
verses.kjv: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, [there is] no transgression.
verses.web: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

verses.ar: لِهَذَا هُوَ مِنَ ٱلْإِيمَانِ، كَيْ يَكُونَ عَلَى سَبِيلِ ٱلنِّعْمَةِ، لِيَكُونَ ٱلْوَعْدُ وَطِيدًا لِجَمِيعِ ٱلنَّسْلِ. لَيْسَ لِمَنْ هُوَ مِنَ ٱلنَّامُوسِ فَقَطْ، بَلْ أَيْضًا لِمَنْ هُوَ مِنْ إِيمَانِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، ٱلَّذِي هُوَ أَبٌ لِجَمِيعِنَا.
verses.kjv: Therefore [it is] of faith, that [it might be] by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.web: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

verses.ar: كَمَا هُوَ مَكْتُوبٌ: «إِنِّي قَدْ جَعَلْتُكَ أَبًا لِأُمَمٍ كَثِيرَةٍ». أَمَامَ ٱللهِ ٱلَّذِي آمَنَ بِهِ، ٱلَّذِي يُحْيِي ٱلْمَوْتَى، وَيَدْعُو ٱلْأَشْيَاءَ غَيْرَ ٱلْمَوْجُودَةِ كَأَنَّهَا مَوْجُودَةٌ.
verses.kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, [even] God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
verses.web: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

verses.ar: فَهُوَ عَلَى خِلَافِ ٱلرَّجَاءِ، آمَنَ عَلَى ٱلرَّجَاءِ، لِكَيْ يَصِيرَ أَبًا لِأُمَمٍ كَثِيرَةٍ، كَمَا قِيلَ: «هَكَذَا يَكُونُ نَسْلُكَ».
verses.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.web: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

verses.ar: وَإِذْ لَمْ يَكُنْ ضَعِيفًا فِي ٱلْإِيمَانِ لَمْ يَعْتَبِرْ جَسَدَهُ - وَهُوَ قَدْ صَارَ مُمَاتًا، إِذْ كَانَ ٱبْنَ نَحْوِ مِئَةِ سَنَةٍ - وَلَا مُمَاتِيَّةَ مُسْتَوْدَعِ سَارَةَ.
verses.kjv: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara’s womb:
verses.web: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

verses.ar: وَلَا بِعَدَمِ إِيمَانٍ ٱرْتَابَ فِي وَعْدِ ٱللهِ، بَلْ تَقَوَّى بِٱلْإِيمَانِ مُعْطِيًا مَجْدًا لِلهِ.
verses.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.web: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

verses.ar: وَتَيَقَّنَ أَنَّ مَا وَعَدَ بِهِ هُوَ قَادِرٌ أَنْ يَفْعَلَهُ أَيْضًا.
verses.kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.web: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

verses.ar: لِذَلِكَ أَيْضًا: حُسِبَ لَهُ بِرًّا».
verses.kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.web: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

verses.ar: وَلَكِنْ لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنْ أَجْلِهِ وَحْدَهُ أَنَّهُ حُسِبَ لَهُ،
verses.kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.web: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

verses.ar: بَلْ مِنْ أَجْلِنَا نَحْنُ أَيْضًا، ٱلَّذِينَ سَيُحْسَبُ لَنَا، ٱلَّذِينَ نُؤْمِنُ بِمَنْ أَقَامَ يَسُوعَ رَبَّنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْوَاتِ،
verses.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
verses.web: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي أُسْلِمَ مِنْ أَجْلِ خَطَايَانَا وَأُقِيمَ لِأَجْلِ تَبْرِيرِنَا.
verses.kjv: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.web: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
